description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring slender equal-width trunk with steeply angled bristle fans and paired smooth palps.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：细等宽躯干、陡斜刚毛扇及成对光滑头须。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level living reconstruction planning study; named fossil morphology informs the proposal, with uncertain soft anatomy kept explicit.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级活体复原规划，参考具名化石形态；软组织等不确定部分须明确标注。

distinctness.en: Compare actual setal-bundle architecture with Canadia, not just overall body width. The narrow body with discrete angled bristle fans must remain visually distinct from Canadia's broad overlapping dorsal bristle coverage; otherwise replace this slot rather than stretch or shrink the same worm.
distinctness.zh: 须比较与 Canadia 的真实刚毛束结构，不能只比较体宽。本属窄体与分离斜向刚毛扇必须区别于 Canadia 宽阔重叠的背侧刚毛覆盖；否则应替换此项，不能仅拉长或缩小同一种虫体。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish slender equal-width trunk with steeply angled bristle fans and paired smooth palps in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence. Comparison gate: Compare actual setal-bundle architecture with Canadia, not just overall body width. The narrow body with discrete angled bristle fans must remain visually distinct from Canadia's broad overlapping dorsal bristle coverage; otherwise replace this slot rather than stretch or shrink the same worm.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以细等宽躯干、陡斜刚毛扇及成对光滑头须搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。 比较审核：须比较与 Canadia 的真实刚毛束结构，不能只比较体宽。本属窄体与分离斜向刚毛扇必须区别于 Canadia 宽阔重叠的背侧刚毛覆盖；否则应替换此项，不能仅拉长或缩小同一种虫体。

original_inventory.uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established. Independent silhouette review remains open against Canadia; taxon evidence is direct but low-poly separability is not yet approved.
original_inventory.reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene. Paired-form review: compare Canadia before production. If the source-backed morphology collapses to the same low-poly construction, replace this concept.

reference_preflight.limitations: Full8640x5760 original specimen-photo panel downloaded and inspected. Need final maker to inspect own pixels and read newer2015 revision before freeze.
reference_preflight.diagnostic_notes: Nearly constant trunk width except tapered ends, two smooth elongated head tentacles; first parapodia single-branched, remaining segment appendages double-branched. Source says roughly two dozen; choose explicit source-supported count and avoid conflating Canadia.

newer_primary_conflict.finding: 2023 Spence Shale paper genus diagnosis states biramous parapodia on all segments, segment1 ramus smaller; ROM says first uniramous. Resolve explicitly before freeze, do not silently blend sources. cf. B. setigera specimens must not be called exact Burgess Shale lectotype.

source_conflict_resolution.title: Cambrian stem-group annelids and a metameric origin of the annelid head
source_conflict_resolution.finding: Parry, Vinther & Edgecombe2015 explicitly re-examine the first segment and report both branches on all segments, revising older uniramous interpretation. ROM first-segment sentence is outdated relative to this paper; use and cite the revision, not a blended compromise.
source_conflict_resolution.evidence_status: Primary indexed text read; full paper figure consultation remains separate. ROM full specimen pixels inspected.
source_conflict_resolution.photo_trap: Dark expelled fecal strand on counterpart is not an elongated body tail; no modeled fecal tail.
